title.zh-TW: 列表縮圖放大成詳細頁
title.en: List thumbnail grows into a detail view

summary.zh-TW: 點列表裡的一張卡片，縮圖本身從原本的位置「長大」成詳細頁的大圖，接著標題和內容依序進場；關閉時大圖縮回原本那張卡片。App Store、相簿、電商商品頁常見的「共用元素轉場」，讓使用者知道新畫面是從哪裡來的。
summary.en: Tap a card and its thumbnail grows from where it sits into the detail view’s hero image, then the title and text come in; closing shrinks it back into the same card. The “shared element transition” seen in app stores, photo apps and shops — it shows where the new screen came from.

text.zh-TW: 縮圖和大圖是兩個不同的元素，但給它們同一個 data-flip-id，Flip 就會把它們當成同一個東西：記下縮圖的位置，讓大圖從那裡長出來。和練習 6（同一張卡片換 class）不同，這裡是「兩個畫面之間」的轉場。
text.en: The thumbnail and the hero are different elements, but sharing a data-flip-id makes Flip treat them as one: it records the thumbnail’s box and grows the hero from there. Unlike practice 6 (one card changing class), this transitions between two views.

text.zh-TW: state 是從縮圖記下來的，targets 指定要動的是大圖。關閉時反過來：從大圖記下 state，targets 改成縮圖。
text.en: state is captured from the thumbnail and targets says the hero should move. Closing reverses it: capture from the hero, target the thumbnail.

text.zh-TW: 用縮放而不是改寬高：裡面的圖示會跟著一起放大縮小，而且只動 transform，比較順。
text.en: Uses scale instead of width/height, so the icon inside grows along with it, and only transforms change — smoother.

text.zh-TW: 打開時焦點移到返回鈕、返回後回到原本的卡片，鍵盤使用者不會迷路；按 Esc 也能關閉。
text.en: Focus moves to the Back button on open and back to the card on return so keyboard users stay oriented; Esc also closes.
